dataset_source: Pinned MLPerf Tiny 248-recording accuracy set selected from the ToyADMOS ToyCar development archive

measurement_protocol.device_synchronization: synchronize immediately before and after the measured inference region
excluded_phases: selective source-recording fetch and librosa feature extraction
TFLite weight parsing and PyTorch model construction
binary feature loading and sliding-window view construction
one shape warmup and one untimed complete accuracy-set pass
per-recording reconstruction-score aggregation and ROC AUC computation
measurement_protocol.timing_scope: 10 repetitions of all 48,608 sliding-window autoencoder inferences after model, data, and one complete-set warmup are ready

public.rationale: Direct MLPerf Tiny ToyCar autoencoder and complete 248-recording accuracy-contract adaptation; claims remain withheld until a committed five-run timing sweep is complete.

reviewer_notes: The 0.85 ROC AUC threshold, ToyCar task, 248-recording index, feature recipe, and autoencoder are inherited from MLPerf Tiny.
The exact PyTorch adapter reproduces the official restricted-set float TFLite AUC at 0.9029100529100529.
Promotion still requires committed five-run timing evidence on the reference platform.
